title: Emergency Vehicle: Clear the Intersection, Then Pull Right
short: A fire engine is behind you.
intro: You are already crossing the intersection. A fire engine approaches with red lights and a siren.
watchCaption: Already in the intersection; the fire engine is behind you.
safeCaption: Clear the intersection. Pull right and stop.
unsafeCaption: The fire engine’s route is still obstructed.
safeFeedback: You clear the intersection, pull to the right edge, and stop while the fire engine passes.

feedback.stop-intersection: Stopping inside blocked the fire engine’s path. Clear the intersection before pulling right.
feedback.continue-normal: You stayed in the fire engine’s path. Clear the intersection, then pull right and stop.
